I have Fireshot installed, but you don't need any plugin to get a fullpage screenshot with Firefox. Simply press 

SHIFT + F2

The type the following in the command line window at the bottom of the screen:

screenshot <filename>.png --fullpage

The subsequent screenshot will be in your Firefox Downloads folder/directory.
